coinbase_ripple.status: RLUSD is available across Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail on XRPL, Base and Ethereum; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was described as forthcoming, not live.

ripple_company_claims.note: Ripple's Oct 28, 2026 business update cites approximately $900M annualized product revenue run-rate, $16T transaction value enabled in 2025 and 1,700+ institutions. These are company claims and aggregate product metrics, not audited XRP settlement volume or XRP demand.

evernorth.sec_capital: SEC prospectus distinguishes $272.6M gross closing cash, 388.91M XRP contributed in kind, 84.3659M XRP purchased using $214.05M cash, $30M PIK-note debt, conditional ELOC capacity with zero proceeds as of Nov 9, and secondary resales that do not generate issuer proceeds.
evernorth.sbi_ownership: Prospectus identifies four SBI-controlled subscriber entities and approximately 39.9% SBI-group voting power. The group had 9.431M Class A shares (36.1% of Class A) and 2.359M non-voting Class C shares (7.5% of Class C). Voting power is not capital contribution or total economic ownership. The exact SBI cash/XRP subscription allocation is not disclosed.
evernorth.direct_vs_group: The Oct 12 SEC 8-K lists SBI Holdings beneficial ownership of 9.431M Class A and 2.359M Class C; this is not a separate capital-contribution disclosure.
evernorth.coinbase_link: Evernorth's prospectus names Coinbase as principal XRP market for financial reporting, not as exclusive execution venue or custodian. The Block reported a planned Q4 institutional-strategy rollout involving Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo; deployment amount and execution not independently verified.
evernorth.personnel_bridge: Evernorth appointed Hugo Jeandesboz, formerly Coinbase Asset Management co-CIO and a former Coinbase derivatives trader, as CIO. This is a personnel connection, not proof of a Coinbase corporate investment in Evernorth.

circle_coinbase.direct_relationship: Circle's 2023 Collaboration Agreement makes Coinbase a paid USDC distributor and gives Coinbase a minority equity stake; Circle acquired Coinbase's remaining 50% of Centre for $209.9M in approximately 8.4M Circle shares and moved to sole USDC network governance.
circle_coinbase.disclosed_equity: Circle's 2025 S-1 showed Coinbase with 8.367M Class A shares before the IPO (4.0%) and 7.902M after the offering (3.7%; 2.6% voting power). This is the last explicit percentage found; no newer 2026 Q2 percentage confirmed.
circle_coinbase.actual_distribution_cost: Circle's Q2 2026 10-Q reports $655.3M of H1 2026 distribution costs under its Coinbase agreements ($324.6M in Q2). The agreement allocates economics based on USDC held on Coinbase and Coinbase's share of residual ecosystem economics after issuer retention and approved-participant payments.

circle_sbi.joint_venture: Circle SBI Japan K.K. is 50/50 Circle/SBI. Circle's Q2 2026 10-Q says each contributed yen worth approximately $1.5M in November 2025 and there had been no significant operating results by June 30, 2026.
circle_sbi.other_sbi_investments: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank separately invested $25M each in Circle's IPO; SBI Group also participated in the Arc validator cohort and Arc presale consortium. Arc is a separate Layer 1, not XRPL.

circle_xrpl.status: Circle USDC has been natively available on XRPL since June 12, 2025; it is a competing dollar settlement asset on XRPL, not XRP.

institutional_and_capital.relationships_summary: Coinbase-Circle is a direct equity, distribution and revenue-sharing relationship. Ripple-Coinbase is an RLUSD distribution/listing relationship plus indirect Evernorth personnel/market links. SBI-Ripple includes a 60/40 software JV that does not itself handle XRP directly plus a separate SBI Remit/SBI VC Trade/Tranglo XRP remittance route. SBI-Circle is a 50/50 Japan JV and Arc validator/investor relationship. Ripple and Circle are competing stablecoin issuers on XRPL; no direct Ripple-Circle JV verified. BNY is a common institutional counterparty, not proof of direct Ripple-Circle partnership.
